name: Wings
signature: Flock: Wings ignore column limits when stated; supporters among them are plentiful.
setBonus: 2: Wings +1 range. 4: Wings' first shot each turn ignores Guarded and Hide.

name: Hooves
signature: Charge: Straight attackers that move or push; fast and wide support.
setBonus: 2: Hooves +1 ATK on the first turn. 4: Swift for all Hooves.

name: Fangs
signature: Pounce and Rend: the only family that can carry overkill.
setBonus: 2: Fangs Straight attackers gain Rend. 4: Rend cap 3 becomes 4 and Pounce +1.

name: Coils
signature: Coil: Pierce and poison; many evolve from fish or lizards.
setBonus: 2: Pierce hits deal +1 to the second enemy. 4: Venom stacks to 4.

name: Shells
signature: Carapace: slow growth and column defence.
setBonus: 2: Shields +1 block. 4: first strike each turn on the hero is halved.

name: Packs
signature: Howl: strongest when several stand in a row; tricksters live here.
setBonus: 2: Packs +1 ATK in a row of 2+. 4: Mark spreads to the neighbour column.

name: Fins
signature: Current: chains and row buffs; Fins thrive next to Water.
setBonus: 2: Chain jump +1. 4: every Fins unit counts as Water for reactions.

name: Chitin
signature: Swarm: many small bodies; cheap squad cost for brood units.
setBonus: 2: Drones get +1 ATK. 4: Chitin cost 1 less Command Point (min 1).

name: Wilds
signature: Wild Card: solitary beasts that fill any hole; tricksters and oddities.
setBonus: 2: one Wilds unit counts as any family for sets. 4: two do.
